policy.manual_merges: Named links below join reviewed close paraphrases across template keys; shared intent/feature alone does not establish a link.
policy.duplicate_links: Eligible duplicate sources participate in group union before one accepted copy is retained.
policy.similarity_audit: SequenceMatcher >=0.88 on normalized templates flagged cross-group pairs for manual inspection only; scores never made a grouping decision.
policy.limits: Conservative template-held-out evaluation policy; manual paraphrase boundaries are subjective and revisable.
